up: From the ChEMBL database, retrieve the distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers (chembl_id), compound names (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), and canonical SMILES for all molecules that are referenced in the document with CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3044971'. Only include molecules where the canonical SMILES is not null. Order the output by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3044971' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
